criteria.evidence: Every route dispatches through the declarative table; token is the default, the open allowlist is explicit + reviewed (OPEN_ROUTES). criteria.evidence: Every mutation-of-record appends a schema-versioned journal event alongside the legacy stores. The classifying parity gate re-derives the session/effort views with zero divergence, and the recovery tool rebuilds a deleted index.json from the journal in a test — the 'lost from an index' bug class is recoverable-by-construction.

criteria.title: Supervisor split — restart survival, live-proven
criteria.evidence: Jobs are owned by a separate stdlib supervisor (own NSSM service, loopback token-authed IPC, inline seam for tests). The hermetic gate proves a simulated-restart re-adoption with tail cursors intact; the two live probes (claude --version under the account, breakaway child survives a supervisor restart) are wired. The live cross-process demo (nssm restart anchor with a job in flight) is the runbook cell — honestly narrowed until run WITH John. PTYs: the ConPTY spike verdict was YES → the adoption follow-on is scheduled; the pre-restart drain remains the safety net.
